title: African American Studies, B.A. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: Built from the archived 2023-24 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan and Program Requirements tabs, cross-checked via a raw-HTML BeautifulSoup table parse (not WebFetch's summary) to rule out the known confabulation risk on archive.psu.edu pages -- the parsed Fall/Spring subtotals (16+16+16+15+15+15+16.5+15.5) sum to 125, matching the page's own stated 'Total Credits 125' exactly. Confirmed byte-identical to the 2022-23 edition (AFAM-2022.json) in every Suggested Academic Plan cell and every Program Requirements course list, aside from three cosmetic course-title/whitespace-only diffs in the open-ended Area of Concentration list (e.g. 'AFAM 197: Special Topics' trailing-space variants) that don't touch any code this JSON references. Real, confirmed difference from AFAM-2026.json: this 2023-24 edition has NO 'LA 83' (1.5cr First-Year Engagement course, Fall Y1) and NO 'LA 283' (1.5cr Second-Year Liberal Arts Seminar, Spring Y2) -- those two College-of-Liberal-Arts requirements first appear starting with the 2025-26 edition (confirmed by diffing all 5 archived years 2022-2026 directly). That 3-credit gap (125 vs 2026's 128) is a real curriculum addition, not a modeling bug, so this file's Semester 1 and Semester 4 simply omit those two items and their target_credits drop by 1.5 each. Everything else -- Prescribed Courses (AFAM 100N/110N/AFAM-HIST 152), the three 3-credit Additional Courses pools, and the 18-credit Area of Concentration (12+6 credits across the same 4 domains) -- is confirmed identical to 2026, including this edition's still-current 'BA Other Cultures' wording (renamed 'BA World Cultures' starting 2024-25; both fold into the same generic 'B.A. Knowledge Domain' slot per this codebase's existing convention). Carries forward, unchanged, the same two real-gap fixes AFAM-2026.json's own notes describe, because this edition's own bulletin has the identical underlying pools: SOC 1 added as an explicit Semester 3 item (this edition's own Semester 4 SOC 207 pick requires SOC 1 per soc_catalog.json, and this major's plan never otherwise schedules it); AFAM 101N modeled as a literal pick from the bulletin's own 7-option Semester 2 pool rather than the full pool, so that AFAM 401's real prereq on it resolves. Semester 1/2 item arrangement (AFAM 110N and the GEN ED GQ tag placed in Semester 1 rather than Semester 2, where the raw bulletin table itself actually shows AFAM 152/HIST 152 in Fall and AFAM 110N + the Quantification GenEd in Spring) intentionally mirrors AFAM-2026.json's own established arrangement rather than the page's literal row order, for internal consistency across this major's 5-year file family -- both orderings are functionally identical and the swap already exists in the trusted 2026 template; flagged separately rather than corrected here, since fixing AFAM-2026.json itself is out of this build's scope. 'AFAM 4XX' and 'AFAM Any Course or Elective' slots match the bulletin's own open-range Area-of-Concentration phrasing, same convention as 2026. SEMESTER-ORDER FIX (2026-09-18 review pass): AFAM 152/HIST 152 and AFAM 110N (plus the GEN ED GQ tag) were swapped between Semester 1 and 2 relative to the real bulletin -- confirmed via a fresh scraper/archive re-parse that AFAM 152/HIST 152 belongs in Fall (Semester 1) and AFAM 110N + the Quantification Gen Ed belongs in Spring (Semester 2). Corrected; re-verified 0 warnings.
